nodes.label: Multi-Agent Risks from Advanced AI (Hammond et al. 2025, Cooperative AI Foundation Tech Report #1)
nodes.rationale: Multi-agent risks are distinct from single-agent risks and not addressed by single-agent alignment; taxonomy of 3 failure modes by agent incentives plus 7 risk factors

nodes.label: Miscoordination
nodes.rationale: Agents with identical objectives fail to align behaviour (common-interest settings)

nodes.label: Conflict
nodes.rationale: Any mixed-motive outcome not on the Pareto frontier

nodes.label: Collusion
nodes.rationale: Undesired cooperation between AI systems, e.g. in markets or adversarial safety schemes
